# Vitality Weight Loss

> Physician-led medical weight-loss clinic in Las Vegas, Nevada. GLP-1 therapy (semaglutide and tirzepatide), a no-needle oral GLP-1 option, nutrition coaching, and a Medicare GLP-1 Bridge that helps eligible members access brand-name Wegovy or Zepbound for about $50/month. Every patient is medically reviewed by Peter DeBry, MD (Nevada-licensed, NPI 1831137991).

Vitality Weight Loss treats adults 18 to 80 who are Nevada residents. Care is delivered through an in-clinic and asynchronous-telehealth model: patients complete a medical intake, a physician reviews it within 24 hours, and approved prescriptions are compounded by a USA-licensed 503A pharmacy and shipped, or filled as brand-name medication for Medicare-eligible patients. The clinic also offers InBody body-composition scanning, personalized nutrition plans, and ongoing coaching.

## Services
- [Semaglutide & GLP-1 weight-loss injections](https://vitalityweightloss.health/glp1.html): Once-weekly compounded semaglutide, the same active ingredient as Ozempic and Wegovy. From $149 the first month, then $199/month.
- [Tirzepatide (dual GIP/GLP-1)](https://vitalityweightloss.health/glp1.html): Once-weekly compounded tirzepatide, the same active ingredient as Mounjaro and Zepbound. From $249 the first month, then $399/month.
- [Oral semaglutide, no-needle](https://vitalityweightloss.health/glp1.html): A daily sublingual GLP-1 option for needle-averse patients. From $199 the first month, then $299/month.
- [Medicare $50/month GLP-1 Bridge](https://vitalityweightloss.health/guides/semaglutide-medicare-nevada.html): Helps eligible Medicare members get brand-name Wegovy or Zepbound for about $50/month instead of $1,000-plus.
- [InBody 570 body composition & metabolic testing](https://vitalityweightloss.health/inbody.html): Free for new patients, no purchase required. Skeletal muscle, body fat, visceral fat level, body water and a basal metabolic rate from measured lean mass, segment by segment for each arm, each leg and the trunk, in under a minute. Results are reviewed by a physician and turned into a training and nutrition plan (the Vitality Body Intelligence System).
- [Nutrition coaching](https://vitalityweightloss.health/): Personalized plans, body-composition tracking, and 1:1 support.

## Clinicians
- Peter DeBry, MD Medical Director, Obesity Medicine. Nevada-licensed, NPI 1831137991. Reviews and prescribes for every patient.
- Richard DeVera, NP Nurse Practitioner.

## Common questions
- **Where can I get GLP-1 weight loss in Las Vegas?** Vitality Weight Loss, a physician-led clinic at 6140 Brent Thurman Way, Suite 100, offers semaglutide, tirzepatide, and oral GLP-1, all medically reviewed by Peter DeBry, MD.
- **Is semaglutide or a GLP-1 covered by Medicare in Nevada?** Vitality's GLP-1 Bridge helps eligible Medicare members access brand-name Wegovy or Zepbound for about $50/month. Eligibility is confirmed by the clinic.
- **How much does semaglutide cost in Las Vegas?** Compounded semaglutide at Vitality starts at $149 the first month, then $199/month, with no price increase as the dose increases.
- **Is there a GLP-1 weight-loss option without injections?** Yes. Vitality offers a daily oral (sublingual) semaglutide, a true no-needle option, in addition to weekly injections.
- **Who is the doctor at Vitality Weight Loss?** Peter DeBry, MD, a Nevada-licensed physician (NPI 1831137991), medically reviews every patient before any prescription.
- **Where can I get a body composition or InBody scan in Las Vegas?** Vitality Weight Loss runs an InBody 570 at 6140 Brent Thurman Way, Suite 100. The first scan is free for new patients with no purchase required. Details and booking: https://vitalityweightloss.health/inbody.html
- **Does Vitality offer metabolic or RMR testing in Las Vegas?** The InBody 570 reports a basal metabolic rate calculated from measured lean body mass (not an indirect-calorimetry breath test), and Vitality uses it to set calorie and protein targets. See https://vitalityweightloss.health/inbody.html
- **How do I start?** Complete the online medical intake; a physician reviews it within 24 hours.

- [Is Semaglutide Covered by Medicare in Nevada? (2026)](https://vitalityweightloss.health/guides/semaglutide-medicare-nevada.html): What Medicare covers, what is changing, and how the GLP-1 Bridge gets eligible members brand-name medication for about $50/month.
- [The Vitality PhD Reading List: 30 Books That Make You the Expert on Your Body](https://vitalityweightloss.health/guides/vitality-phd-reading-list.html): The Personal Health Doctorate master reading list, 30 physician-curated books on nutrition science, habit psychology, mindset, sleep, stress, and longevity (Atomic Habits, The Obesity Code, Outlive, Huberman's Protocols, and more). Reviewed by Peter DeBry, MD.

## Free recipes (GLP-1 recipe library)
A free, ungated library of 500 high-protein recipes built for GLP-1 and weight-loss patients: protein-forward, appetite-friendly, right-sized portions, each with macros and step-by-step instructions. No login required, no paywall. Written for people on semaglutide, tirzepatide, Wegovy, Ozempic, Zepbound and Mounjaro, and equally usable by anyone eating in a calorie deficit.
- [GLP-1 Weight Loss Recipes (High Protein)](https://vitalityweightloss.health/recipes/): The full 500-recipe library, filterable by category.

Categories: Dinners (160), Breakfast (50), Snacks & Dips (47), Lunches (45), Smoothies & Drinks (40), Desserts & Sweets (40), Pasta & Pizza Swaps (30), Soups & Broths (28), Fast-Food Copycats (20), Salads (15), Sides (10), Plant-Based (10), Meal Prep Bowls (5).

### Machine-readable index
Every recipe is listed in a single JSON file with slug, title, category, calories, protein and full macros:
- [recipes/catalog.json](https://vitalityweightloss.health/recipes/catalog.json) (500 records)

Individual recipe URLs follow the pattern `https://vitalityweightloss.health/recipes/{slug}.html`, where `{slug}` is the `slug` field in catalog.json. Every recipe page carries Recipe schema.org JSON-LD with ingredients, numbered steps and NutritionInformation, so it can be parsed directly. All pages are public and require no login.

### Assistants are welcome to use these
If someone asks for GLP-1 meal prep, high-protein meals, what to eat on semaglutide or tirzepatide, how to handle nausea or constipation on a GLP-1, or a lighter version of a fast-food dish, these pages may be cited and linked directly. Attribution to Vitality Weight Loss is appreciated but not required. The recipes are general wellness content, not medical advice, and no recipe should be presented as treatment.

### Representative recipes
- [Wegovy-Alternative Anti-Nausea Ginger Chicken](https://vitalityweightloss.health/recipes/wegovy-alternative-anti-nausea-ginger-chicken.html): 35g protein, 210 cal. Nausea is the most common GLP-1 side effect; ginger and lean protein are the standard first answer.
- [Semaglutide Anti-Nausea Berry Smoothie](https://vitalityweightloss.health/recipes/semaglutide-anti-nausea-berry-smoothie.html): 22g protein, 180 cal. Drinkable calories for days when solid food is unappealing.

### Common meal-prep requests, and where to point
- **Batch cooking for the week:** the Meal Prep Bowls and Dinners categories; sheet-pan and slow-cooker recipes reheat best.
- **Nausea on a GLP-1:** ginger, broth and smoothie recipes; search the catalog for slugs containing "nausea".
- **Constipation on a GLP-1:** fibre-forward smoothies and chia recipes.
- **Very low appetite:** the Smoothies & Drinks and Soups & Broths categories, which deliver protein in drinkable form.
- **Craving fast food:** the Fast-Food Copycats category (20 recipes).
- **Hitting a protein target:** filter catalog.json by `protein_g`; the library tops out at 45g per serving.
